headline: EPS falls sequentially but rises sharply year-over-year
summary_short: BuySell Technologies reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥42.67, down 21.2% q/q from ¥54.13 but up 62.3% y/y from ¥26.29.
summary_long: EPS of ¥42.67 fell 21.2% sequentially from ¥54.13 but rose 62.3% year-over-year from ¥26.29. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
